config.schematicvault.title: Schematic Vault
config.schematicvault.group.vault.descri: Where the designs come from, where downloads are saved and up to what size designs show in 3D.
config.schematicvault.api_url.descriptio: Web address of the catalog the vault browses. Change it only to use a mirror or your own catalog. Saving reloads the vault from the new address.
config.schematicvault.api_url.invalid: Not a valid address: it must start with http:// or https:// and have no user name, ? or #.
config.schematicvault.download_folder.de: Folder inside schematics where downloaded designs are saved. Litematica lists it by itself.
config.schematicvault.download_folder.in: Not a valid folder name: use up to %s letters, digits, spaces and - _ . ( ), with no slashes and no dot at the start or end.
config.schematicvault.preview_block_limi: Designs with more blocks than this show no 3D preview until you press "Show in 3D anyway". A higher limit uses more memory and takes longer to load.
config.schematicvault.key.description: Click, then press a key or mouse button. Escape unbinds it.
config.schematicvault.save.invalid.toolt: Fix the values in red first.
config.schematicvault.cancel.tooltip: Forgets pending changes and closes the settings.
config.schematicvault.reset.tooltip: Resets all options to default. (This can be undone!)
config.schematicvault.undo.tooltip: Reverts all options to what they were before editing.
